records.process_summary: UT Knoxville publishes a central financial-aid appeals process covering multiple appeal types. Documentation generally must be received at least 14 business days before the last day of classes for the appealed semester.
records.notes: Published deadlines include Fall 2026, Spring 2027 and Summer 2027 term deadlines.

records.process_summary: The published HOPE & Institutional Scholarship Appeals route addresses loss of existing scholarship eligibility due to extenuating circumstances. It does not, on the reviewed page, document a process for negotiating an incoming merit award or matching a competing offer.
records.notes: Do not treat scholarship-retention appeals as proof that UT negotiates initial merit offers.

records.process_summary: No documented competing-offer review process was found on the reviewed official UT financial-aid appeal pages.
records.notes: Because absence is harder to prove than presence, recheck scholarship/admissions policy pages before treating this as durable negative evidence.

records.process_summary: UT accepts Special Circumstances Appeals for documented changes such as loss of employment/income, death of a wage earner, certain marital changes, significant medical expenses and other listed circumstances.

negotiation_addon_gate.reason: No verified incoming merit-reconsideration or competing-offer-review path has been documented. Existing scholarship-loss and special-circumstances appeals do not qualify the product's negotiation add-on.
